# Agentic RAG {#sec-agentic-rag}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- turn retrieval from a fixed pipeline step into a tool the model chooses to use;
- decompose a complex query into retrievable sub-questions;
- bound an iterative retrieval loop so it terminates and stays affordable;
- measure agentic RAG against classic RAG rather than assuming it is better.

## Exercises

1. Take five multi-hop questions your classic RAG fails. Does agentic RAG fix them, and at what cost multiple?
2. Instrument the retrieval loop and plot answer quality against number of retrieval rounds. Where is the knee?
